character_economy_analysis.explicitly_still_not_established: Which provider component. No hypothesis is selected. The greedy-fixed-point reading is recorded as consistent with every measurement and cheap to kill, NOT as a conclusion - MEDAUTH has no view into the decoder.
findings: It did not run out of room: 190 non-whitespace characters is LESS than any other intake cell, and a sixth of the 1098 produced by intake/gold_note/short which terminated in 478 tokens.

The document never closes, so the whitespace is emitted while it is still OPEN. Trailing whitespace after a complete document would still parse; this does not. This contradicts the 'after a structurally complete state' wording the escalation carried since Phase 16.
It is a deterministic fixed point: byte-identical across 12 observations in two runs taken hours apart at temperature 0.
An exit exists and is reachable: intake/filler/long entered a 770-character whitespace stretch under the same schema and still closed, which argues against a grammar with no terminal state.
character_economy_analysis.note: Arithmetic over already-committed observations. No provider was contacted to derive any of this.

Any other firewall failure mode has been tested or excluded.

gate_effect.only_transition: provider-side fix evidence -> scripts/r86_revalidate.py --write -> PASS -> the official evaluation gate opens. FAIL and INCONCLUSIVE both remain blocked.
gate_effect.why: Attribution is not a fix. The production cell still fails 6/6, the gate still reads 6/12 = 0.5000 against the pre-registered ceiling of 0.10, and R-86 remains a VERIFIED FAILURE. This evidence is not grounds for a revalidation either: revalidation asks whether the defect is gone, and this says it is present.

entries.as_stated: grammar/whitespace handling after a structurally complete state
entries.reason: The failing responses remain structurally INCOMPLETE. parsed_as_json is false on all eighteen observations across three runs; trailing whitespace after a complete document would still parse. The 'after a structurally complete state' clause is not supported as stated.
entries.what_survives: Whitespace is legal between tokens of an OPEN document too, so a whitespace-consumption mechanism is not excluded - only the claim that it begins after completion.

entries.as_stated: a greedy fixed point on a whitespace token at temperature 0
entries.reason: r86-temperature-perturbation-001 trial 5 escaped the whitespace pattern entirely - 3316 non-whitespace characters at 13% whitespace - and STILL reached the ceiling without closing. The sampler left the whitespace path and termination did not follow.
entries.what_survives: Five of six trials at temperature 0.2 were byte-identical to greedy, which is consistent with the whitespace continuation holding a large share of the probability mass. That is an observation, not a mechanism.

entries.as_stated: the answer was genuinely too long for the 1536-token ceiling
entries.raised_in: implicit in early readings of finish_reason=length
entries.reason: The failing cell produces 190 non-whitespace characters - LESS than any other intake cell, and a sixth of the 1098 produced by intake/gold_note/short which terminated cleanly in 478 tokens. It did not run out of room; it stopped producing content.
entries.residual: Trial 5 of the temperature diagnostic produced 3316 non-whitespace characters and also hit the ceiling. That single observation is NOT excluded as an ordinary length truncation, and is recorded as ambiguous rather than folded into either reading.
